dedupe_keys.name: india major chemical production kaggle table

description: Timoth Dev A shares a CSV table of major chemical production in India, attributed to the Ministry of Chemicals and Fertilizers and its Department of Chemicals and Petrochemicals. The description identifies product, product group and year as the reporting dimensions. Figures aggregate monthly production returns submitted by large and medium manufacturers. The registry title places the series in 2013 to 2020, but individual year completeness and the precise scaling of the filename unit were not checked. Kaggle states CC0 and free access. A limitation is the exclusion of smaller manufacturers from the stated reporting population and the lack of a linked original statistical release. Simulation uses include historical chemical-output scenarios and industrial material-demand estimates after checking units. It complements data-open-power-system-data with industrial production context. Only the provider description and one-file manifest were read; no table values or national totals were inspected.
